# Why won't this GPX file upload?

> Free GPX checker: finds why Strava, Garmin Connect or Komoot rejects a track file, with line numbers: missing creator, version and namespace, GPS jumps, points at 0,0, timestamps out of order, no times, bad elevations. Downloads a repaired copy. Runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
